current_prompt.body:
READ the set S = {3, 34, 7, 12, 5, 26, 11, 8, 15, 2, 19, 21}
READ the target sum T = 40
APPLY a backtracking algorithm that explores the full search tree to identify every subset of S whose elements sum exactly to T
FOR each solution found
EMIT the subset
VERIFY that the sum of its elements equals T
ENDFOR
COUNT the total number of solutions and REPORT this count

current_plan.body:
READ the set S and the target sum T
APPLY a backtracking algorithm that exhaustively explores the search tree to discover every subset of S whose elements sum to T
FOR each discovered subset
EMIT the subset
VERIFY that the sum of its elements equals T
ENDFOR
COUNT the total number of solutions
REPORT the count
